evidence: CORRECTED during re-base. _SECRET_RE covers more than the first edition implied: password= / secret= / token= / api_key= assignment forms, Bearer <token>, PRIVATE KEY, and two provider shapes (sk-[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}, ghp_[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}).
